_comment: Recorded accept-page exchange for the emailed invite link (#4367). Replayed by tests/test_email_integration_resend.py::test_invite_link_contract_is_hermetic so the link contract is asserted with NO network; the live half (test_invite_link_resolves) re-verifies the deployed page behind ALLOW_PROD=1 + @pytest.mark.live. Only the STABLE contract headers are recorded — Cloudflare's per-request headers (date, cf-ray, report-to, nel, alt-svc) are deliberately omitted, because recording them would make the cassette rot on every request instead of on a real contract change. Re-record when the deployed redirect chain or referrer policy actually changes. Re-recorded 2026-11-11 for #11767: the builder now emits the app origin's TERMINAL form, so the chain is one exchange with no redirect at all. The retired 301 hop (tortoise.premiselabs.co/invite-accept.html -> app.premiselabs.co/invite-accept) was dropped from the recording because it is no longer traversed — and it stays live for links already sent.
